title: Derived direct image
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$, an integer $n\in\mathbf
Z_{\geq1}$, and put $A=A_{E,n}$. Let $X,Y$ be schemes on which $\ell$ is
invertible, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]; write $f_n$ for this morphism at
coefficient level $A_{E,n}$. On the small pro-etale sites
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with derived pullback and internal
Hom notation [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and derived tensor
notation [def-weil-derived-tensor], the functor
$f_*:\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$
[def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image] is left exact
[lem-weil-proetale-module-direct-image-left-exact]. At
finite level, choose a K-injective resolution [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions] and
define its total right-derived functor
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] by

$$
 Rf_{*,n}=R(f_n)_*:D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})
 \longrightarrow D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n}).
$$

For a derived-complete integral [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]
complex $K\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$, define

$$
 Rf_*K=
 R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_{*,n}
 \bigl(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\bigr).
$$

Here $D(-,\mathcal O_E)$ and the restriction of scalars
$\operatorname{Res}_n$, applied termwise (it is exact
[lem-weil-restriction-of-scalars-exact]), are those of the completed
coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and
$R\varprojlim_n$ is the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit] in
$D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, which exists because countable products
of pro-etale module sheaves are exact
[lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact, lem-weil-derived-limit-existence].
The tower maps are induced by $A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$: the map
$K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n+1}\to K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}$,
followed by the identification of $R(f_{n+1})_*$ of an
$A_{E,n}$-module complex with $R(f_n)_*$ of it
[lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. The
finite-reduction comparison is the natural map

$$
 (Rf_*K)\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}
 \longrightarrow
 Rf_{*,n}\bigl(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\bigr),
$$

adjoint [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction] to the
projection of $R\varprojlim$ onto its $n$-th term;

its being an isomorphism, and its compatibility with composition and scalar
extension, are separate comparison assertions, not part of this definition of
the derived direct image. Here $A_{E,n}$ and finite-level constructibility
are the finite-torsion coefficient data
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], and $\mathcal H^r$ is the
cohomology-sheaf functor [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. For
$\Lambda=E$ use the rationalized category
[def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]; for $\Lambda=\Qlb$ use the common-stage
category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients].

proof.text: Use the finite-rational adjunctions and invertible scalar-change mates. The defining counit equation implies unit compatibility by transposition. Transpose both sides of the right-family associativity equation; counit naturality, the mate equation and left-family coherence prove equality. Thus the right functors form a stage-system morphism and both adjunction transformations form compatible families. Descend these transformations on the actual pair category, including both triangle identities. Identify the descended left functor with commonStageDerivedPullback using its exact object and representative formulas.

The geometric fibre of each finite-type quasi-compact model is Noetherian and has finite topological Krull dimension. Stalk invertibility follows from residue-field invertibility. The coherent coefficient comparison supplies the common-stage identity isomorphism. Together with pullback composition and the inverse geometric Frobenius this proves that Frobenius pullback is an equivalence. Lift the geometric adjunction to IsoAlgebra using the mate of the normalized Frobenius square.

Apply uniqueness of right adjoints to compare the selected Weil right adjoint with the lifted geometric right adjoint. Forget its structure and project the canonical counit equation to the carrier map. If another isomorphism satisfies that equation, injectivity of the inverse geometric Hom equivalence gives equality of every component.

proof_origin: E1, 2026-10-20: finite-stage adjunction descent on actual pair representatives; explicit Frobenius equivalence; IsoAlgebra mate lifting; uniqueness of the counit-normalized forgetful comparison. No arbitrary-field duality branch is used.

mathlib_searches.results: CategoryTheory/Functor/Derived/RightDerived.lean: `HasRightDerivedFunctor`, `Functor.totalRightDerived` (abstract total right derived functor between localized categories, existence assumed); Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/RightDerivedFunctorPlus.lean: `Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlus` on `DerivedCategory.Plus` (bounded below, enough injectives); CategoryTheory/Abelian/RightDerived.lean: `Functor.rightDerived F n` on objects via injective resolutions
mathlib_searches.verdict: generalization only: the abstract derived functor exists in Mathlib, but not its existence on unbounded derived categories of sheaves via K-injective resolutions, nor the direct image of sheaves on pro-etale sites

mathlib_searches.results: `CochainComplex.IsKInjective` (Algebra/Homology/HomotopyCategory/KInjective.lean, DerivedCategory/KInjective.lean: Hom into a K-injective complex in the derived category); no theorem that every complex in a Grothendieck abelian category has a K-injective resolution; `IsGrothendieckAbelian (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab)` instance in ElladicCohomology.lean
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match for the unbounded K-injective derived direct image

mathlib_searches.results: `Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous`, `SheafOfModules.pushforward` along continuous functors; small pro-etale site `Scheme.ProEt S`, `ProEt.topology S`; no base-change functor between small pro-etale sites

mathlib_searches.verdict: no match for the derived limit $R\varprojlim$ (it is def-weil-derived-limit)

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the master blueprint node (order 1468); slopmaster2 has no Lean for it (state none) and no separate blueprint file for this node. The mathematical content is unchanged; the statement now names every notion it is built from, by bracketed references added to its existing sentences: the underived direct image of pro-etale module sheaves (new node def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image) and its left exactness (new lem-weil-proetale-module-direct-image-left-exact); the K-injective resolutions (def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions) and the finite-level derived direct image $R(f_n)_*$, which is $Ru_*$ of def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations with $u=f$ and coefficients $A_{E,n}$; $D(-,\mathcal O_E)$ and $\operatorname{Res}_n$ (def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, being split by another worker) with the exactness that lets $\operatorname{Res}_n$ act termwise on derived categories (lem-weil-restriction-of-scalars-exact); $R\varprojlim$ as the Roos-triangle derived limit (def-weil-derived-limit), whose existence needs countable products in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ (lem-weil-derived-limit-existence part 2, with the exactness of countable products of pro-etale module sheaves, new lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact from Bhatt-Scholze 3.1.9, 3.2.3, 4.2.8); the tower maps, which need the identification of $R(f_{n+1})_*$ on $A_{E,n}$-complexes with $R(f_n)_*$ (new lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars, Stacks 0D6E); and the finite-reduction comparison map, defined as the adjoint of the projection $R\varprojlim\to$ $n$-th term under $-\otimes^L A_{E,n}\dashv\operatorname{Res}_n$ (new lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction, Stacks 07A6). Kept the blueprint's dependencies (scheme morphisms, pro-etale site, derived pullback/tensor/Hom notation, derived tensor, $D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$, finite-torsion constructibility, cohomology sheaves, rationalized and common-stage categories). Mathlib has abstract total right derived functors, K-injective complexes, pushforward of sheaves along continuous functors and the small pro-etale site, but not the pro-etale base-change functor, unbounded K-injective resolutions of sheaves, or derived limits; searches recorded.

lean.note: The recorded SfIntegralDirectImage supplies only the completed integral reduction tower. This module publicly retains that construction and extends it to the actual geometric common-stage category and its induced Weil pairs by the inverse-image adjunction. The forgetful comparison is uniquely normalized by its counit; shift and open-exchange comparisons use the prescribed pullback comparisons.
